SQLite: many small reads and writes (OLTP) by one application
DuckDB: analytical questions over many rows and few columns (OLAP)
vectorised: batches of up to 2,048 values

SQLite: type affinity: 'two' stored as text in an INTEGER column, unless STRICT
DuckDB: strict: 'two' refused with a Conversion Error

SQLite: unlimited readers, one writer at any instant
DuckDB: one process can write a database file; others may read

SQLite: no; import with the CLI (.import --csv) or Python
DuckDB: yes: SELECT … FROM 'file.csv' / read_csv / Parquet / JSON

SQLite: phones, browsers, desktop programs, small sites
DuckDB: notebooks, analysis scripts, data pipelines, DBeaver
